name: show-and-tell-monorepo
description: ShowAndTell - Standalone JavaScript Screen Recording SDK and Demo

scripts.build: pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm run build:react
scripts.test: pnpm run test:sdk && pnpm run test:react
scripts.lint: pnpm run build:sdk && pnpm --filter @divmora/show-and-tell run typecheck && pnpm --filter show-and-tell-server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @divmora/show-and-tell-react run typecheck
scripts.start: pnpm run build && pnpm run build:server && pnpm run demo

author: DIVMORA Technologies
